title: Clopen factorization, pullback comparison and its coefficient compatibility predicate
statement: For normalized ringed data c,o,sp,e of [def-pur-ringed-refinement-data] and arrows k:U→V,r:U→W,p:V→Z,i:W→Z, Factorization is the data of H over T and b:H→V,q:H→W,s:U→H, with pullback properties over T and on underlying schemes, equations sb=k,sq=r, b and s open and s with clopen image. For k,i open and a Factorization d, define t_R:i_!,R⋙p_R^*→r_R^*⋙k_!,R as beta, followed by the clopen projector, the pullback compositor for sq=r and the open compositor for sb=k. These are the original explicit definitions, moved unchanged so the pre-mate theorem and its consumer can name the same map without a cycle. PullbackCompatibility is the proposition structure with the single field equation λ_p(i_A N);S_V(t_A N);δ_k(r_A^*N)=p_B^*(δ_i N);t_B(S_W N);k_B(λ_r N), universally in N. It is only a named presentation of this pre-mate equation and does not assert that it holds.

mathlib_searches.query: Change of rings preserves a proper open mate by adjunction and a compatible left adjoint square
mathlib_searches.results: CategoryTheory.mateEquiv_apply, mateEquiv, mateEquiv_counit, mateEquiv_square, iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv, mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_vcomp, mateEquiv_counit_symm, mateEquiv_symm_apply.
mathlib_searches.verdict: The mates equivalence exists in Mathlib, but the explicit unit/whiskering/counit word is recorded as a direct generic constructor so its specialized use does not kernel-normalize derived functor constructions. No arbitrary mate data is introduced.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Adjunction/Mates.lean:245 and Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Bicategory/Adjunction/Mate.lean:362 give mateEquiv_square. Repository searches find RingedRefinementClopen (only identity-left refinement compatibility), SemilinearScalarProperOpen and SemilinearAlphaPullback (constant coefficient towers), not this arbitrary ring-sheaf pullback identity. blueprint_refs.py search "clopen coefficient" returns 0 blueprint nodes. blueprint_refs.py search "adjunction mate" returned det-ctf-finite-proper-localizing, det-sp-reduction-compatibilities, lem-cbc-extension-zero-base-change, lem-sf-projection-finite-constant; none is this generic constructor.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No existing arbitrary ring-sheaf general-square pullback identity. Reuse the existing normalized operations and split only the geometric compatibility step.

def t {m : Mode} {T : Scheme.{u}} {c : Coefficients m T} {o : Calculus c}
    {sp : Spatial o} (e : OpenComparisons sp)
    {U V W Z : Over T} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W) (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion k.left] [IsOpenImmersion i.left]
    (d : Factorization k r p i) (R : Rings m T) :
    o.shriek i R ⋙ (o.operation p R).left ⟶
      (o.operation r R).left ⋙ o.shriek k R
lean.note: Original Factorization and t moved verbatim from the item to this public dependency; no changed map, signature or proof hole. PullbackCompatibility contains exactly the pre-mate equation as a Prop field; it is a performance interface, not assumed data.
